प्रच्छ् vt. 6P (pp. पृष्ट; pres. पृच्छति; caus. प्रच्छयति; desid. पिपृच्छिषति) (This is one of those roots which take two accusatives, e.g. माणवकं पंथानं पृच्छति) 1. To ask, to question, to interrogate, पृच्छामि त्वां धर्मसंमूढचेताः Bg.ii.7, R.iii.5, Bt.vi.8; 2. to seek, to seek for.With अनु-, to question about.With आ-, 1. to ask, to question; 2. (Atm.) to take leave of, to bid adieu to, आपृच्छस्व प्रियसखममुं तुंगमालिंग्य शैलम् Megh.i.12.With परि-, to ask, to question, to inquire.
प्रच्छद m. A cover, a wrapper, a bed-cover, R.xix.22.
प्रच्छद-पट m. the same as प्रच्छद q.v.
प्रच्छन n. Inquiry, interrogation.
प्रच्छना f. Inquiry, interrogation.
